# Configuring the egress proxy for the {{ zero_trust_full }} {#zero-trust-manager-proxy_{{ context }}}

Operator Lifecycle Manager (OLM) automatically configures managed Operators with proxy settings when you use a cluster-wide egress proxy. To support proxying HTTPS connections, you can inject certificate authority (CA) certificates into the {{ zero_trust_full }}.

## Additional resources {#zero-trust-manager-proxy_additional-resources}

- [Configuring proxy support in Operator Lifecycle Manager](/openshift-docs-markdown/operators/admin/olm-configuring-proxy-support#olm-configuring-proxy-support)
